prerequisiteQuestions.question: Which regulated sportsbooks and timestamps define the official 'Opening' and 'Closing' benchmark lines?
prerequisiteQuestions.decisionBlocked: Computing Closing Line Value (Gate G4) and Realized Edge on originated Week 10/11 lines.

prerequisiteQuestions.answerNeededBeforeDecision: Approve 3+ regulated books, Shin vig-removal, and T-5 min pre-kickoff closing snapshot.
prerequisiteQuestions.discoverySuggestion: Evaluate licensed odds feed providers or state-regulated bookmaker APIs in user's legal jurisdiction.

prerequisiteQuestions.question: What multi-season play-by-play and snap-participation source will calibrate 2nd/3rd/4th-string point drop-offs?

prerequisiteQuestions.discoverySuggestion: Cross-link NFL Official Game Books (offensive/defensive snap counts) with NFL Next Gen Stats / licensed PBP archives.

prerequisiteQuestions.question: What are the true single-game joint correlations (copula r) between player prop pairs inside Same-Game Parlays?

prerequisiteQuestions.question: What is the empirical 2024-2026 NFL Home-Field Advantage (HFA) in points after accounting for travel and rest?
